data.name: Faatihah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word fa'at (to open), Faatihah is a name that signifies the opener or the one who opens. In Islamic tradition, it is believed to be the name of the first Surah (chapter) of the Quran, which is a source of guidance and wisdom. The name Faatihah is thus symbolic of opening doors to knowledge, spiritual growth, and enlightenment.
